item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud dbang drag dkyir 'khor bum pa'i ti ka
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan phag lo sbas pa'i rong bzhi shar phyogs rong gi dbang phyug ri bo'i byang phyogs nyi ma rang shar mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas chen/ seng gdong phug pa'i nang du zla tshes kyi nyi dros skabs su/ rigs mthun mkha' 'gro'i grogs dang bstan pa'i yon bdag dang grwa slob bdun bcas te khrom gter du bgyis shing / slar zla tshes la pho brang chen po drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse nas shog ser la bod yig tu bsgyur ba grub pa'o//
